verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS business-incorporation and back-office platform, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no such control. The only opt-in mentioned is the Firstbase Discovery program, which governs whether VCs can see your business. That is an adjacent feature, not a telemetry or analytics opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
